name: @polycrestlabs/agentkit-ui
description: The AgentKit conversation UI kit for Angular: the v2 frame vocabulary (loaded/token/tool/question/questionForm/followups/citation/usage/heartbeat/message/done/error), the agent-turn state machine with an ordered rich timeline and durable hydration, and the full component set — transcript, composer, question cards, presentation-only proposal cards, followup chips — restyled onto --agentkit-* tokens, plus the transport/confirm injection seams and a fixture-replaying stub transport.
